jobs.name: build
jobs.title: Build
jobs.description: Cleans and recompiles dist/; every job that reads or rewrites dist/ shares this lane so none races it.

rc.title: Bump the version and draft the notes on rc-X.Y.Z, made from develop
Write the {version} section of docs/changelog.md
rc.manual: In the release worktree (../SaaSFoundry-release, prepared on the RC branch rc-X.Y.Z made from develop), write the {version} section of docs/changelog.md. The cut commits it with the version.

rc.title: Write the {version} section of docs/fr/changelog.md
rc.manual: In the release worktree (../SaaSFoundry-release, prepared on the RC branch rc-X.Y.Z made from develop), write the {version} section of docs/fr/changelog.md. The cut commits it with the version.

rc.title: Commit the candidate on rc-X.Y.Z and tag it there
rc.confirm: Pushes rc-X.Y.Z with the release commit of {tag} and the tag on its head. No publish workflow starts on the tag (test.yml runs on it), and nothing reaches master or develop.

public.title: Bump the version and draft the notes on rc-X.Y.Z, made from develop
Reconcile master into rc-X.Y.Z when they diverged (merge -s ours; nothing to do otherwise)
Write the {version} section of docs/changelog.md
public.manual: In the release worktree (../SaaSFoundry-release, prepared on the RC branch rc-X.Y.Z made from develop), write the {version} section of docs/changelog.md. The cut commits it with the version.

public.title: Write the {version} section of docs/fr/changelog.md
public.manual: In the release worktree (../SaaSFoundry-release, prepared on the RC branch rc-X.Y.Z made from develop), write the {version} section of docs/fr/changelog.md. The cut commits it with the version.

public.title: Commit the release on rc-X.Y.Z and open its pull request to master
public.confirm: Pushes rc-X.Y.Z with the release commit of {tag} and opens its pull request to master.

public.title: Merge the pull request into master once CI / Required gate is green
public.confirm: Merges the pull request of {tag} into master with a merge commit once CI / Required gate is green.

public.title: Tag the merge commit and push the tag: publish-stable.yml starts on the tag
public.confirm: {tag} is public once pushed: publish-stable.yml starts on the tag, and the environment npm-production asks for an approval on GitHub.

public.title: Close the milestone once the release is published
Merge master back into develop with a merge commit
public.confirm: Opens the pull request of master (at {tag}) into develop and merges it with a merge commit once its checks are green, never squash or rebase: master must become part of develop's history, or the branches diverge again.
